name: VERTICAL AUTOCLAVE WING NUT
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-WX-AU-360 Vertical Autoclave is an ergonomically designed, fully automatic laboratory sterilizer distinguished by its highly reliable wing nut lid locking mechanism. This sturdy, manual locking system ensures exceptional operator safety and prevents accidental opening during high-pressure cycles.
features: Highly reliable Wing Nut Locking Mechanism for maximum operator safety
Fully Stainless Steel 304 construction sealed with a self-inflating silicone rubber seal
Microprocessor Soft Key Pad Controller with LED Display
Automatic Steam Discharge and Shut-Off with Beep Alert post-cycle
2 Nos. Stainless Steel Sterilizing Baskets included

specifications.Equipment Configuration: Vertical Autoclave with Wing Nut Lock
specifications.Post-Cycle Operation: Automatic Steam Discharge and Shut-Off with Beep Alert
specifications.Standard Safety Features: Low Water Level Protection, Over Temperature Protection, Over Pressure Protection
specifications.Target Applications: Microbiology Labs, Hospital Sterilization, Pharmaceutical Decontamination
